text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft claimed victory in the Shuka 
Sho. She and her rival Air Messiah praised 
each other for having given it their 
absolute all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah told Rhein Kraft: You are an 
Umamusume who illuminates the hearts of 
others. One can't help but look up to 
someone like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft was walking on air with joy. 
Her classmates looked up to her—she had 
truly managed to pass her feelings on to 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To continue carving her own path, she set 
her sights on her next goal: the race to 
determine spring's fastest Umamusume, the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
